title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 496  An Act Converting and Integrating the San Enrique National Agricultural and Vocational High School and the San Enrique National High School in the Municipality of San Enrique, Province of Iloilo, Into a College to Be Known as the San Enrique Agricultural College and Appropriating Funds therefor.

text.en:
The San Enrique National Agricultural and Vocational High School and the San Enrique
National High School in the Municipality of San Enrique, Province of Iloilo, are converted and integrated into
a college to be known as the San Enrique Agricultural College.

All assets, obligations and appropriations of the San Enrique National Agricultural and
Vocational High School and the San Enrique National High School, whether fixed or movable, records and
personnel are transferred and/or absorbed by the San Enrique Agricultural College.

The existing appropriations for the San Enrique National Agricultural and Vocational High
School and the San Enrique National High School are hereby transferred to the San Enrique Agricultural
College, to be disbursed in accordance with the provisions of this Act. The necessary sum for the operation
and maintenance of the college shall be provided for in subsequent General Appropriations Acts, until which
time the operation of the institution as a college shall be deferred, provided that its new name shall take effect
upon approval of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
